_comment: The job that must conclude success on the closure SHA after the already
deployed release SHA has produced the evidence needed to close TASKBOARD.md.
This is intentionally separate from required-jobs.json: deployment is gated
at the release SHA, while final acceptance is gated at a later closure SHA.
scripts/check-release-closure.mjs proves that the closure is the release's
single direct child changing only TASKBOARD.md, and that the final-run SHA
(the main head the job ran on) is the closure itself or a later linear
descendant whose intervening commits change only non-runtime paths
The closure TASKBOARD must contain the exact SHA-256 produced by canonical
postdeploy attestation; canonical finalize reuses the same digest.

required_jobs.name: Release-final taskboard completion
required_jobs.why: runs at the final-run SHA (the closure SHA itself, or a later non-runtime-only descendant of it), requires the workflow's release_sha input to name the deployed release SHA, closure_sha the TASKBOARD-only closure record, and acceptance_digest the canonically attested bundle, checks that exact release-to-closure and closure-to-final relationship, and requires every TASKBOARD row to be complete

notes: Neither the closure SHA nor the final-run SHA is a second application release
and neither may replace the exact SHA recorded by canonical deployment evidence.
A missing job, skipped job, non-success conclusion, missing release_sha or
acceptance_digest input, or failed release-closure check is a refusal.
